name: gemini-cli
description: Google's Gemini CLI (@google/gemini-cli 0.65.0), run headless (gemini -o stream-json --approval-mode yolo --skip-trust, prompt on stdin) against the organization's Gemini API provider at the platform's gateway (GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL with the per-turn token as GEMINI_API_KEY); the CLI speaks only the Gemini API. Assistant text streams as output_text deltas; shell runs become shell_call items, write_file/replace become apply_patch_call items, MCP tools become mcp_call items and every other tool a function_call, each with its output; usage comes from the run's stats. Turns after the first resume the CLI's own session; instructions and system/developer messages (a user-level context file), reasoning.effort, text.format, input files and images, the turn's MCP servers, max_tool_calls and max_output_tokens are mapped, every helper model the CLI uses is pinned to the requested one, and request fields the CLI cannot honour are named in metadata.hg_ignored_fields.
